title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Binance $6.3B hot-wallet breach confirmed (Oct 29) — largest crypto hack ever. Lazarus Group suspected; exchange pledges full coverage; Tether froze $1.56B.
BTC ~$77,800 (-3.5% 24h est.) on hack fallout; Standard Chartered expects further losses.
$11B BTC+ETH monthly options expire today (Deribit) — BTC pinned near/below $78K max pain.
Polymarket also breached Oct 30 (~$3M lost); international trading suspended.
